item_short_desc: Get up and go with our Lightweight Woobie Tote bag, offering plenty of space for carrying everyday essentials, clothing, laptop, large tablet, and more. The large military-styled tote bag ensures your possessions are safe and secure while providing additional storage space anywhere you go. The quilted tote bag measures approximately 18 inch x 15 inch x 5 inch overall and has a 23L storage capacity.
description: Get up and go with our Lightweight Woobie Tote bag, offering plenty of space for carrying everyday essentials, clothing, laptop, large tablet, and more. The large military-styled tote bag ensures your possessions are safe and secure while providing additional storage space anywhere you go. The quilted tote bag measures approximately 18 inch x 15 inch x 5 inch overall and has a 23L storage capacity. From Tactical Roots to Everyday Utility: Inspired by the dependable versatility of the iconic poncho liner, Rothco’s Woobie collection embodies rugged style and practicality. Each item, from our durable outerwear to the premium Tote Bag, features a distinctive quilted pattern and lightweight filling, combining unique style with everyday functionality. Convenient Design: The crossbody shoulder bag features an open top with a magnetic closure for quick and easy access to your belongings. In addition, the dual 35 inch shoulder straps for comfortably across your shoulders and body for easy carry. Additional Pockets: These quilted crossbody bags feature 2 inner storage pockets and 1 outer pocket for securing electronics, accessories, and small items. The Go-Anywhere Bag: Whether you are relaxing at the beach, on a road trip, or walking through town, these multipurpose military tote bags provide extra storage and carrying capacity, ideal for traveling and everyday use.
